name: fass
description: Packed messages and directly navigable binary schemas for TypeScript and AssemblyScript
author: Jairus Tanaka

scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.ts' 'test/*.ts' 'test/*.mjs' package.json tsconfig.json README.md spec/status.md && prettier --plugin assemblyscript-prettier --write assembly/index.ts
scripts.bench:compare: npm run build && tsc -p bench/tsconfig.json && node bench/compare.mjs
scripts.bench:generate: npm run build && node bench/generate.mjs && tsc -p bench/tsconfig.json
